prompt:
Analyze this P&ID and identify the major process system, equipment, equipment tags, process relationships, and any uncertain elements. Do not invent unreadable information.

Structured extraction requirements:
You are inspecting a Piping & Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID). Reply with ONE compact JSON object only (no prose, no markdown). Keep EVERY array short (at most 10 items). Only list equipment/tags you can CLEARLY read. If something is unreadable, write the string 'uncertain'. NEVER invent tag numbers, pressures, temperatures or specifications. Schema:
{
  "plant_system": "<short phrase (verified|probable|uncertain)>",
  "equipment": ["<name (status)>"],
  "equipment_tags": ["<tag (status)>"],
  "pumps": ["<tag/name (status)>"], "vessels": ["<tag/name (status)>"],
  "reactors": ["<tag/name (status)>"], "valves": ["<tag/name (status)>"],
  "instruments": ["<tag/name (status)>"],
  "process_streams": ["<desc + direction (status)>"],
  "relationships": ["<visible relationship (status)>"],
  "uncertain": ["<unreadable/ambiguous/conflict (uncertain|not_visible|conflict)>"]
}
Hard limit: AT MOST 8 items TOTAL across all arrays. If the drawing is dense, list only the few clearest items. If a category is absent use []. Stop immediately after the closing brace.
